text_block_list.text: While taking a morning walk along the riverbank—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hup, hup...
Ah, <username>!!
choice_data_list: Good morning! Full of energy today, aren't you?
Morning! Look at all that energy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, <username>!
It's such a refreshing morning today, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I could run laps all day! Have a great walk, okay?
See ya around!

Mejiro Ryan called out cheerfully before dashing off.
Though she was only jogging at an easy pace, her solid, stable form was mesmerizing.

...Still, it's about time students start getting ready for school.
Will she be okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah... Huh?!
choice_data_list: (Did she realize what time it is...?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, right! I wanted to try out that new running drill!
All right, one more lap... No, five more laps...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?!
Huh, from earlier... What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, late?
...Wait, GAAAH! Is that really the time?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa-whoa, <username>...!!
The morning felt so great that I totally lost track of time!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I gotta run!
Thank you so, so much—!!

Displaying her magnificent stride once more,
Mejiro Ryan bolted off in a flash...
Later that day, after classes—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're the person from this morning...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Looking closely at your lapel pin...
Oh! You're an Academy Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for this morning!
Thanks to you, I didn't end up late... You really saved me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I really want to thank you properly, but, hmm...
Oh, I know!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um, would you mind coming with me right now?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All right, here we are!!
Now, to thank you for this morning—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Let's do some strength training together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yep! Because this is probably the best kind of thank-you I can give!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was little, I've just loved moving my body, so to be honest,
I don't really have many other strong points besides that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But because of that, I can teach you all about the joy of working out!
I can even design a workout routine tailored perfectly to your muscles!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wait... um, was that too sudden?
Is something like this really no good as a thank-you after all...?

Seeing my hesitation, Mejiro Ryan's shoulders slumped dejectedly.
It would be too cruel to leave her like this...
choice_data_list: Well, since we're here, why not...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really?! Awesome!!
Go get changed, and let's get straight to it!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! How is it, Trainer?!
Are you feeling the raw awesomeness of lifting right in your muscles?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Looks tough, but you're doing great!
Everything we've done so far has officially awakened your dormant muscles!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get you a full-on workout next!!
Are you hydrated? Then let's do this—muscle up!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
One more! Just one more! ...Hit your limit?
Then one last rep! ...Alright, that's a wrap!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Outstanding! Way to go! Your body's thanking you for it!
Can you hear it? Your pecs cheering in sheer joy!!
choice_data_list: I think I actually hear them...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! Looking great!
Let's keep this momentum rolling right into the second half!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, this is really, truly the final stretch!!
Trainer, count it out loud with me!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ooooone!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Threeeeeeeee!!
...Alright, awesome work today!!

A pleasant exhaustion washes over my whole body. The routine
she put together was serious, high-level training...!
choice_data_list: Is this what your normal solo training looks like...?
Is this what your normal solo training looks like...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Today was a routine customized just for you, Trainer.
Normally, I do... about three times that much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Still, the harder you push, the more refined your body gets.
And if you keep putting in the work, it'll pay off in the end!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Shaving even a single second off your time feels amazing...
And the moment you produce real results in a race is something else entirely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the finish line faster than anyone else, ahead of the whole pack—
that feeling...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That rush of heat slowly spreading through a body you built yourself...
There's nothing else in the world like it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Though I guess that's really all there is to it.

Mejiro Ryan seemed a little off for a second,
but before I could ask her about it, someone came running up.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-chan?
...Ah, knew I'd find you here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ines! What's up?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The Debut Selection Race is coming right up, yeah?
We're at the final prep stage, so I was hoping we could do some parallel running!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sweet! Count me in!
Alright, let's head out right now!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's my Ryan-chan, always ready to roll♪
I'll go on ahead and wait for you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer, thanks a ton for today!
I'm gonna head out now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Catch ya later!!

...Entering a Selection Race with her future on the line meant
I'd soon get to see Mejiro Ryan running all-out, powered by her hard-trained body.
Quietly looking forward to that moment, I left the gym.
